name: Node Comics GPU 0.1.1 (CUDA 12.8.1)
desc: Pinned Vast CUDA base + checksummed runtime release. 2 compute, 8 in flight, 6 download, 6 delivery.
readme: Use SSH launch mode and the supplied on-start script. Fill a NEW independent NODE_ID, NODE_TOKEN and NODE_RESOURCE_ID before renting; center execution_slots=8. Never save real credentials into the template or account-wide variables. Runtime downloads once and verifies SHA-256; subsequent starts reuse it and refuse identity changes. GPU warmup precedes registration; inspect /var/lib/node-comics/state/status.json and center heartbeat. Requires Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Python 3.12, CUDA 12.8/cuDNN 9 and host NVIDIA Vulkan drivers. No application inbound ports. Stop/start preserves state; recycle/destroy without a volume loses it: drain and back up first. No in-place automatic upgrades.
